Who We Are
Applied Materials is a global leader in materials engineering solutions used to produce virtually every new chip and advanced display in the world. We design, build and service cutting-edge equipment that helps our customers manufacture display and semiconductor chips – the brains of devices we use every day. As the foundation of the global electronics industry, Applied enables the exciting technologies that literally connect our world – like AI and IoT. If you want to push the boundaries of materials science and engineering to create next generation technology, join us to deliver material innovation that changes the world.
What We Offer
Salary:
$131,000.00 - $180,000.00
Location:
Santa Clara,CA
You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more.
At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits.
TEAM OVERVIEW:
We are a passionate, cross-functional team at the forefront of applying cutting-edge AI and machine learning to accelerate scientific and materials innovation. Our mission is to create domain-specific, product-centric algorithmic solutions that drive real impact for our customers.
We thrive in a collaborative environment that encourages out-of-the-box thinking and values diverse perspectives. Here, creativity flourishes—groundbreaking ideas are born from the synergy of technical expertise and open-minded teamwork. We believe the best solutions emerge when everyone is empowered to share their unique insights and challenge conventional boundaries.
Our team leverages state-of-the-art generative AI and large language models to tackle complex problems in materials science, scientific discovery, and hardware design. We work closely with scientists, engineers, and product leaders to translate frontier research into practical, high-value applications.
Ideal candidates bring a strong research background, technical leadership, and a passion for learning new technologies. If you are excited to solve complex problems, drive innovation, and help shape the future of science with AI, join us on our journey to make possible a better future through intelligent discovery.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
Develop, pretrain, fine-tune, and align LLMs and generative models tailored for scientific and materials science data, literature, and workflows.
Innovate post-training methods, alignment, and evaluation for domain-specific LLMs, ensuring models are robust, accurate, and trustworthy for scientific use cases.
Design and implement generative approaches to accelerate materials discovery, hypothesis generation, and hardware design.
Collaborate with scientists, engineers, and cross-functional teams to identify impactful applications of generative AI in materials science.
Build and curate scientific datasets, benchmarks, and evaluation protocols for model validation and continuous improvement.
Stay current with advances in AI, machine learning, and materials science, and publish original research in top venues.
Mentor junior team members and contribute to a collaborative, inclusive research culture.
TECHNICAL SKILLS:
Strong background in machine learning, deep learning, NLP, and generative AI, with a focus on scientific or technical domains.
Hands-on experience with LLM pretraining, supervised fine-tuning (SFT), post-training alignment (e.g., RLHF), and rigorous model evaluation.
Proficiency in Python and frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow.
Experience working with structured and unstructured scientific data (e.g., literature, experimental results, simulation outputs) and developing domain-specific models.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to collaborate across disciplines and present complex ideas to diverse audiences.
REQUIREMENTS/EDUCATION:
MS or Ph.D. degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineer, Electrical Engineer, Mathematics, Statistics or related field

title: Applied Scientist , PAE

Description
Every time a customer checks out, a split-second decision determines which payment method appears, in what ranking, whether there is payment failure risk and how frictionless the experience feels. That decision touches 300MM+ customers and 2B+ monthly transactions — and you'll be the scientist building the intelligence behind it.
Are you excited by the challenge of applying machine learning, GenAI, and real-time personalization to one of the highest-volume, lowest-latency decision systems at Amazon? Do you want to build models that directly move billions in revenue — predicting payment risk before it happens, recommending the right payment method at the right moment, and eliminating friction that customers shouldn't have to think about?
Join Payment Acceptance & Experience (PAE) Data Science, where you'll build the ML systems that power Amazon's Payment Experience Intelligence. You'll take models from conception to production alongside scientists, engineers, and product managers, shipping at a scale few teams in the industry can match.
Key job responsibilities
Build and ship ML systems at scale — design, develop, evaluate, deploy, and monitor ML models that personalize payment experiences for 300MM+ customers across 2B+ monthly transactions.
Solve global problems once — develop worldwide models that scale across business lines and locales with minimal adaptation, and continuously improve model performance and ML architecture.
Own the full lifecycle — contribute production-grade code and science tooling, from experimentation framework to deployed inference.
Measure real impact — design A/B experiments, conduct rigorous statistical analysis, and translate results into product and business decisions.
Ship with engineering and product partners — collaborate with SDEs to take models from prototype to production, and with business stakeholders to drive alignment on science-informed strategy.

The PAE Data Science team builds AI-native intelligence systems that improve payment experience, optimize marketing efficiency, automate operational workflows, and enable faster business decision-making across the payments ecosystem. It serves as a high-leverage, strategic engine advancing PAE's mission.

Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining, a Master's degree or above in Engineering, Computer Science, Machine Learning, Operations Research, Statistics, or related fields

title: Applied Scientist, Amazon Music - Catalog [MusicIQ]
description_preview:
Description
Amazon Music is an immersive audio entertainment service that deepens connections between fans, artists, and creators. From personalized music playlists to exclusive podcasts, concert livestreams to artist merch, Amazon Music is innovating at some of the most exciting intersections of music and culture. We offer experiences that serve all listeners with our different tiers of service: Prime members get access to all the music in shuffle mode, and top ad-free podcasts, included with their membership; customers can upgrade to Amazon Music Unlimited for unlimited, on-demand access to 100 million songs, including millions in HD, Ultra HD, and spatial audio; and anyone can listen for free by downloading the Amazon Music app or via Alexa-enabled devices. Join us for the opportunity to influence how Amazon Music engages fans, artists, and creators on a global scale. Learn more at https://www.amazon.com/music.
Key job responsibilities
Responsibilities
As an Applied Scientist, you will own the design and development of end-to-end systems. You’ll have the opportunity to create technical roadmaps, and drive production level projects that will support Amazon Science. You will work closely with Amazon scientists, and other science interns to develop solutions and deploy them into production. The ideal scientist must have the ability to work with diverse groups of people and cross-functional teams to solve complex business problems. Other responsibilities include:
Collaborate with scientists, engineers, and product managers to define and frame business problems as ML or optimization tasks.
Build, train, and evaluate models using large, complex datasets.
Implement scalable data pipelines and model-serving systems.
Analyze experimental results, draw insights, and refine models to improve accuracy and robustness.
Communicate findings and recommendations to technical and non-technical audiences.
Continuously learn and apply new algorithms and techniques to improve existing systems.
A day in the life
Everyone on our team has a meaningful impact on product features, new directions in music streaming, and customer engagement. We are looking for new team members across a variety of job functions including software engineering/development, marketing, design, ops and more. Come join us as we make history by launching exciting new projects in the coming year.
About The Team
The Amazon Music – Catalog [MusicIQ] Team develops sophisticated models for understanding music across multiple dimensions: sonic, thematic, cultural, lyrical, etc. This team aims to unify this deep music knowledge that will power intelligent music experiences across Amazon Music. Ultimately, the goal of our team is to delivery a musically credible experience, which will help grow engagement across all customers, but also delight the fans!
Basic Qualifications
3+ years of building models for business application experience
PhD, or Master's degree and 4+ years of CS, CE, ML or related field experience
Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language
Experience in any of the following areas: algorithms and data structures, parsing, numerical optimization, data mining, parallel and distributed computing, high-performance computing
Preferred Qualifications
Experience using Unix/Linux
Experience in professional software development

title: Unreal UI Developer (C++/Blueprint)
reason: Stack +6; Title fit +6; Title stack +6; US +10
description_preview:
About Devhouse
Devhouse is a game development studio based in Dallas, Texas. We work across a wide range of game projects, platforms, and genres, bringing together design, art, engineering, production, and QA to solve problems as one team.
We’re looking for experienced Unreal UI Developers to join an upcoming game development project. This role will focus specifically on implementing polished, responsive, and highly animated user interfaces within Unreal Engine.
This is not a generalist software engineering position. The right candidates will have deep experience working in the view layer, strong C++ and Blueprint skills, and a portfolio that demonstrates high quality UI implementation and animation.
About the Role
As an Unreal UI Developer, you’ll work closely with UX designers, UI artists, technical designers, and engineers to translate visual designs and interaction specifications into polished in-engine experiences.
You’ll be responsible for the visual implementation and behavior of menus, HUD elements, transitions, and other interactive UI. This includes building reusable widgets, implementing animation and interaction states, connecting UI elements to underlying data, and ensuring the final experience remains responsive and performant across supported platforms and input methods.
This role requires both technical implementation skills and a strong visual eye. You should be comfortable evaluating timing, motion, layout, transitions, and moment-to-moment feedback rather than considering the work complete once an interface is merely functional.
What You’ll Do
Implement polished game interfaces in Unreal Engine using UMG, Blueprint, and C++.
Translate UX flows, visual designs, motion references, and prototypes into functional in-engine UI.
Build menus, HUD elements, overlays, navigation systems, transitions, and interactive states.
Create high quality UI animations and micro-interactions with strong timing, motion, and visual feedback.
Develop reusable widgets and scalable UI patterns that can be used across multiple screens and features.
Connect view-layer elements to game data and supporting systems while maintaining clear technical boundaries.
Work closely with UX designers and UI artists to preserve the intent and quality of approved designs.
Collaborate with engineers when UI features require changes or support beyond the view layer.
Implement responsive layouts that accommodate different resolutions, aspect ratios, and screen safe areas.
Support mouse, keyboard, controller, and other required input methods.
Debug visual, interaction, navigation, focus, and data-binding issues.
Profile and optimize UI rendering, animation, memory use, and responsiveness.
Participate in reviews and provide practical technical feedback on proposed UI designs.
Maintain clear, reusable, and well documented UI code and Blueprint implementations.
What We’re Looking For
Professional experience specializing in UI development for games or other real time interactive experiences.
Deep experience implementing interfaces within Unreal Engine’s view layer.
Strong C++ and Blueprint skills, specifically as they relate to UI implementation.
Strong experience with Unreal Motion Graphics (UMG) and Widget Blueprints.
A portfolio or reel showcasing polished UI implementation and high-quality UI animation.
The ability to translate finished designs and motion references into responsive in-engine experiences.
A strong eye for layout, timing, transitions, interaction states, and visual polish.
Experience creating reusable widgets and maintainable UI systems.
Experience connecting UI elements to game data and underlying systems.
Experience debugging and optimizing complex interfaces.
A practical understanding of input, focus, navigation, resolution, and aspect-ratio considerations.
Strong communication skills and experience collaborating with UX, art, design, and engineering teams.
Additional Experience That Stands Out
Experience with CommonUI, Slate, or Unreal’s Model-View-ViewModel tools.
Experience developing UI for console or other multi-platform games.
Experience implementing complex controller navigation and input routing.
Experience with UI materials, shaders, or other advanced visual effects.
Familiarity with localization, accessibility, and platform certification requirements.
Experience working within an established design system or large-scale UI architecture.
Experience profiling and optimizing animated Unreal interfaces.
You’ll Be a Great Fit If You
Identify professionally as a UI developer or UI engineer rather than a generalist software engineer.
Care as much about how an interface feels as whether it technically functions.
Can look at a motion reference and recreate its timing, hierarchy, and visual intent in-engine.
Know when to use Blueprint, when to use C++, and how to keep the two working together cleanly.
Build reusable solutions without losing the polish required by a specific screen or interaction.
Communicate comfortably with both visual and technical teammates.
Proactively identify implementation risks and propose practical solutions.
Take ownership of UI features through implementation, review, refinement, and final verification.
How We Work
Our team values people who figure things out, focus on work that moves the project forward, and approach challenges with possible solutions. We believe imperfect action is better than perfect inaction, and we learn by taking thoughtful risks and recalibrating.
We also value T-shaped professionals who understand the broader development process while continuing to deepen their specialty. Most importantly, we operate with a co-op mindset: open communication, shared knowledge, mutual support, and no office politics.
Why Devhouse?
Monthly Game Days dedicated to connecting as a team and playing games
Continuous learning and professional development opportunities
A multidisciplinary team that values and supports everyone’s contributions

MACHINE LEARNING SCIENTIST – FOUNDATION MODELS (AI + BIOLOGY)
United States - REMOTE
$225,000 – $275,000 Base + Equity
The Opportunity
Join a world-class AI research team focused on building foundation models from scratch for biology and scientific discovery.
This is a highly technical, research-driven role for scientists who are excited by first-principles model development, large-scale representation learning, and advancing the frontier of AI in complex scientific domains. You'll work on proprietary, multimodal biological datasets and help develop the next generation of foundation models designed to uncover insights that traditional approaches cannot.
What You'll Do
Design, train, and evaluate novel foundation models on large-scale biological and multimodal datasets.
Develop new approaches in representation learning, self-supervised learning, generative modeling, and model architectures.
Conduct research across training objectives, data curation, scaling strategies, and model evaluation.
Build and run experiments to rapidly test hypotheses and iterate on new ideas.
Own research projects end-to-end while collaborating with ML researchers, computational biologists, and domain experts.
What We're Looking For
PhD or equivalent research experience in ML, AI, Computer Science, Computational Biology, Physics, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related quantitative field.
Strong track record of original research through top-tier publications (e.g., NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, CVPR, Nature Machine Intelligence) and/or impactful industry research.
Experience developing models from first principles, including architecture design, training methodology, and evaluation.
Deep expertise in foundation models, representation learning, multimodal learning, generative modeling, self-supervised learning, or large-scale deep learning.
Strong Python/PyTorch skills with the ability to independently drive research and communicate findings effectively.
Why This Role
Build foundation models from scratch, not just applications on top of existing models.
Work on frontier AI research with direct impact on biology, healthcare, and scientific discovery.
Train models on large, proprietary datasets purpose-built for next-generation AI systems.
Join a research-first team with significant autonomy, ownership, and influence on technical direction.
Competitive compensation, meaningful equity, and flexible hybrid/remote work options.
If you're excited about designing new model architectures, pushing the boundaries of foundation model research, and applying AI to some of the most important scientific challenges of our time, we'd love to talk.

title: Senior Unreal Engineer
description_preview:
About Devhouse
Devhouse is a game development studio based in Dallas, Texas. We work across a wide range of game projects, platforms, and genres, bringing together design, art, engineering, production, and QA to solve problems as one team.
We’re looking for experienced Unreal Engineers who can independently own features, make sound technical decisions, and contribute beyond assigned implementation tasks.
About the Role
As an Unreal Engineer at Devhouse, you’ll work closely with designers, artists, producers, QA analysts, and other engineers to build and maintain gameplay features and supporting systems in Unreal Engine.
﻿
You’ll help translate creative and technical goals into practical implementations, identify risks before they become larger problems, and take ownership of features from technical planning through testing, refinement, and release.
Our projects vary in genre, platform, size, and stage of development. You should be comfortable entering unfamiliar systems, adapting to different technical constraints, and contributing wherever your engineering experience can move the project forward.
What You’ll Do
Design and implement gameplay features and supporting systems in Unreal Engine.
Develop clean, maintainable solutions using C++ and Blueprint.
Independently own features from technical planning through implementation, testing, optimization, and release.
Break larger goals into practical engineering tasks and provide informed estimates.
Make technical decisions that balance quality, maintainability, performance, and production constraints.
Collaborate with designers and artists to turn creative goals into practical technical implementations.
Create tools and workflows that help other disciplines work more effectively.
Integrate animation, UI, audio, physics, input, and other game systems as needed.
Investigate and resolve complex technical and gameplay issues.
Profile and optimize performance across supported platforms.
Review existing systems and identify opportunities to improve reliability, scalability, and maintainability.
Participate in code and Blueprint reviews, providing clear and constructive feedback.
Work with QA to reproduce issues, investigate underlying causes, and verify fixes.
Communicate technical risks, blockers, dependencies, and changing scope clearly.
Document systems and implementation decisions when that context will help the team.
Help less experienced engineers solve problems and strengthen their development practices.
Lead technical planning for larger features or systems.
What We’re Looking For
At least three years of professional game development experience, with significant hands on work in Unreal Engine.
Strong C++ programming skills and experience working within a production codebase.
Strong Blueprint skills and the judgment to determine whether a solution belongs in C++, Blueprint, or a combination of both.
Experience independently owning gameplay features or supporting systems from planning through release.
A solid understanding of software architecture, debugging, performance, and maintainable code.
The ability to evaluate requirements, identify technical risks, and propose practical solutions.
Experience estimating engineering work and communicating progress, blockers, and changing scope.
Experience participating in code reviews and providing constructive technical feedback.
The ability to enter an unfamiliar system or codebase and become productive without extensive step-by-step guidance.
Experience collaborating with designers, artists, producers, QA analysts, and other engineers.
Strong communication skills and the ability to explain technical decisions clearly.
Experience with source control and collaborative development workflows.
A proactive, solution-oriented mindset.
Equivalent professional experience and a strong body of shipped or production quality work may be considered in place of a specific number of years.
Additional Experience That Stands Out
Experience developing games or experiences in UEFN.
Familiarity with Verse and Fortnite Creative systems.
Experience with multiplayer or networked gameplay.
Experience developing for PC, console, mobile, or other performance constrained platforms.
Experience building editor tools or improving content-development workflows.
Experience with build systems, automated testing, continuous integration, or deployment pipelines.
Experience with profiling, memory management, and platform-specific optimization.
Experience shipping a commercial game or supporting a live-service project.
You’ll Be a Great Fit If You
Have enough production experience to recognize common risks before they become larger problems.
Can independently move a feature forward even when every technical detail has not been defined.
Think beyond completing a task and consider how your implementation affects the larger project.
Know when to solve a problem directly and when a decision requires broader team alignment.
Raise technical risks early and bring possible solutions to the conversation.
Investigate underlying causes instead of only addressing surface-level symptoms.
Build systems that other disciplines can understand and use effectively.
Can provide useful technical guidance without taking ownership away from less-experienced teammates.
Balance long-term maintainability with the practical needs of production.
Are comfortable being one of the people the team turns to when a problem is difficult or unclear.
Communicate directly, respectfully, and collaboratively.

Application Engineer II/Senior Application Engineer (III)
Woodward’s Industrial Product Division in Windsor, Colorado is seeking Level 2 or 3 Engineer with expertise in Human Machine Interface (HMI) development and integration. The position is focused on designing, programming, testing, and supporting HMI solutions using platforms such as Ignition, iFIX, and Qt, while developing operator interfaces that integrate seamlessly with turbine and plant control systems in Military Marine applications. The engineer is expected to have strong knowledge of industrial communication protocols including Modbus and OPC, networking and enabling reliable data exchange between controllers, HMIs, and third-party equipment. Additionally, the role involves the creation, configuration, and maintenance of computer system images in both Windows and Linux environments, supporting deployment, validation, and lifecycle management of control system hardware. Success in this position requires strong technical problem-solving skills, the ability to lead design reviews and customer interactions, and experience delivering robust, validated software and HMI solutions for complex marine automation applications
